bout.identity_discriminator: Gi bout, so the kit is unambiguous: Bruno Fernandes Rocha = BLUE gi, white belt (scoreboard 'BRUNO ROCHA / CIA PAULISTA BJJ'); Rafael Silverio da Fonseca = BLACK gi, white belt ('RAFAEL SILVERIO DA FONSECA / SAO PAULO FC JIU JITSU'). Bound to bodies without the name order: at t=379 the referee raises the BLACK-gi athlete's arm and at t=382 the broadcast prints 'VENCEDOR / RAFAEL SILVERIO DA FONSECA' over that same frame, while the scoreboard reads 0 x 9. Every point in the bout is scored by the black-gi athlete, matching the side of the board that reaches 9.
bout.notes: Division banner (t=6, 720p): 'QUARTAS-FINAL / FAIXA BRANCA / MASTER 2 / MEIO-PESADO', 5:00 match. Clock is 05:00 and PAUSED at t=26/28 and 05:00 RUNNING at t=30 -> bout_start = 30, which is exactly what the reading claimed. 00:04 at t=336, 00:00 at t=340 -> time expires at t~340 (306s of video for 300s of clock, i.e. ~10s of stoppage, seen around t=80-95). Final: Bruno 0 pts / 0 vantagens, Rafael 9 pts / 1 vantagem. Scoreboard read at 720p: Rafael's vantagem lands between t=90 and t=120; his points go 0 -> 2 between t=126 and 130, 2 -> 4 between 284 and 288, 4 -> 7 between 288 and 292, 7 -> 9 between 296 and 300. Every kept ts is snapped onto that clock, which is why five of the six moved. Kept 6 of 7 events read.
